page.overview:
What is Zangoid?

The Zangoids are feline creatures with two hands and a lizard-like head and skin (hence why they are also called "centaursnakes"). The creatures are described as fast; while hunting, they attack in packs and use their razor sharp teeth and claws. Also, they prefer to mangle their prey for amusement. The Zangoids are mostly found in bushes on the planet Blior, although it is unknown whether they are native to the planet or if they were brought there by human hunters.
